ops.fulfillment_mode.justification: Product-level metafield. After the plan the product still has OAK 45 and HCK 32 (>= 15, live per-location sums 10+35, 8+24), so IN_STOCK_LOCAL_3PL remains true for the product as sold. Sequoia alone would be LOW_STOCK_PRIORITY (5 units, 1–14) and Walnut LOW_STOCK_PRIORITY (14), but there is no variant-level fulfillment_mode field; the Sequoia exception is carried by the delivery-window text and inventoryPolicy CONTINUE. BACKORDER_BATCH does not apply (SEQ is not 0). Changing the product to LOW_STOCK_PRIORITY would wrongly downgrade Oak/Hickory.
